text:
nicole: Quick sync — we're starting AWS / GCP / Azure marketplace onboarding for the next wave. Need to lock SKU naming, trial entitlements, and telemetry hooks this week. I put a kickoff doc here: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/onboard — pls review.

samir: Thx. For SKU format, do we want a single canonical pattern per cloud? marketplaces tend to require publisher/offer IDs embedded. Proposal: `redwood-<cloud>-<product>-<tier>-<region>-trial` e.g. `redwood-aws-inference-pro-us-west-2-trial`. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

elaine-legal: One note from legal: any SKU that implies duration (e.g., "trial") needs explicit trial T&Cs in the offer metadata or we get pushback in Azure private offers. I'll review the draft offer language but need the anchor text for the EULA and a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) pointer.

jay-eng: On telemetry — we need consistent billing signals across clouds. Suggest emitting a marketplace_event with fields: product_sku, offer_id, plan_tier, user_id_hash. Also include header `X-Redwood-Trace` so we can correlate marketplace ledgers back to inference traces. Example event name: `marketplace.purchase.succeeded`.

nicole: Good call. Can we map telemetry -> usage meter names (tokens, embeddings, sessions) so finance can reconcile? Samir, you own AWS SKU mapping. Jay, you and Alex please pair on GCP/Azure telemetry mapping. Can we get owners in this thread?

samir: I can take AWS mapping. Quick thing: for AWS private offers we need `SellerId` and the `OfferId` in the SKU metadata. Also need a dev test path — recommend a sandbox publisher account we can use for end-to-end tests.

alex-ops: I'll provision the sandbox publisher creds. Heads up: Azure needs a service principal with `Contributor` on the publisher resource group plus `MarketplacePublisher` role for listing. I'll add an ARM role snippet in the kickoff doc.

samir: IAM snippet for AWS private offer tests I pasted in the doc:```\n{\n  "Version": "2012-10-17",\n  "Statement": [\n    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["aws-marketplace:Subscribe","aws-marketplace:ViewSubscriptions"],"Resource":"*"}\n  ]\n}\n```\n
elaine-legal: I'll aim to turn around EULA + DPA language in 3 business days. If you can drop the offer draft link (with sample SKU list) here I'll mark any clauses that need tweaks.

nicole: I'll update the kickoff doc with the SKU table and owners by EOD. Next steps: 1) finalize SKU table, 2) legal review, 3) telemetry mapping + test events, 4) create sandbox offers and run end-to-end in staging. Can we target a staging canary next Tue? :calendar:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: marketplace-onboard/sandbox-provision -> staging at 2024-11-12 03:00 UTC (automated) :robot_face:

jay-eng: +1 for Tue canary. I'll add automated smoke checks to assert event emission and offer metadata in the pipeline.

nicole: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll ping the doc when SKU table is populated. :thumbsup:
